'''Politics and elections'''

**The [[United States]] holds [[United States midterm election|midterm elections]] for 435 [[2026 United States House of Representatives elections|members]] and five [[Non-voting members of the United States House of Representatives|non-voting delegates]] of the [[United States House of Representatives|House of Representatives]], 35 [[2026 United States Senate elections|members]] of the [[United States Senate|Senate]] (including [[List of special elections to the United States Senate|special elections]] in [[2026 United States Senate special election in Florida|Florida]] and [[2026 United States Senate special election in Ohio|Ohio]]), 39 [[U.S. state|state]] and [[Territories of the United States|territorial]] [[2026 United States gubernatorial elections|governors]], and numerous other [[2026 United States state legislative elections|state]], [[2026 United States state legislative elections#Territorial and federal district summaries|territorial]], [[2026 Navajo Nation presidential election|tribal]], and [[2026 United States local elections|local]] officials. **[[News media in the United States|U.S. news]] organizations project that the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]] will control the House of Representatives and the Senate in the upcoming [[120th United States Congress|120th Congress]], ending the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]]'s majority in both chambers.
